name: @arena/expert-intake
description: Arena expert intake — the adaptive capability interview agent (Work Order C003; issue #110). Runs versioned, deterministic, seed-driven interview sessions over the C002 DemandProfile / A004 capability vocabulary with typed interview items (capability probe, experience probe, evidence request, scenario item), next-item selection by expected information value with an inspectable rationale (the capability-case active-learning law), an append-only digest-chained transcript of questions + DECLARED answers, and a typed output contract: a structured IntakeProfile proposal for the A006 registry field groups plus qualification claim candidates with evidence pointers for A007. Claims are INPUT to qualification, never an access grant (lock rules 9/35). The interviewer model sits behind an adapter port with a deterministic scripted reference implementation (lock rule 10); tenant isolation and minimal-PII capture are enforced under the expert's declared privacy policy.
